Gavere

Saturday 26 December 2026

On Saturday 26 December, Gavere hosts the sixth round of the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup. Year after year, the gruelling course ensures a real war of attrition. Last year, Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel claimed victory. Who will emerge as the strongest here?

Tickets

Would you like to join us in Gavere on Saturday 19 December? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Presale: €21.50 (service fee included)

On race day, both at the on-site ticket office and online: €25.00 (service fee included)

Children born in 2014 or later can enter for free, but must still order a child ticket.

 

[GO TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://gavere.tickets.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/selection?language=en)

Hospitality

Experience the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup in Gavere from the front row on Saturday, December 26? Click the button below, download our hospitality brochure and discover our VIP package!

Want to order tickets? Simply send an email to hospitality@ucicyclocrossworldcup.com.

[DOWNLOAD THE BROCHURE HERE](https://flandersclassics.activehosted.com/f/575)

Practical information

Address

Molenstraat, 9890 Gavere

 

Do you have a question?

Contact the organisation [here](https://www.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/en/contact).

How to get there?

By bike

A bicycle parking area is available on Sportdreef in Gavere.

 

By car

Take the E17 exit 8 (De Pinte) towards Oudenaarde, then follow the event signage. Parking is available on Legen Heirweg in Gavere.

 

Parking for people with reduced mobility

Krijgslaan 1, 9890 Gavere

Permanence

Sportdreef 1B, 9890 Gavere

 

Parking

Parking 1 - Warande, 9890 Gavere
